info.title: Mnema Talk API
info.description: REST API of Mnema Talk, a self-hosted, invite-only chat and voice app for a single community. Authentication is an HttpOnly session cookie set by login/register. State-changing requests (anything but GET/HEAD/OPTIONS) must carry a same-origin Origin header, otherwise 403. JSON bodies are decoded strictly: unknown fields are rejected with 400 and bodies are limited to 1 MiB. Errors share the ErrorResponse shape. Everything except the SPA assets lives under /api.

STUN servers and, when configured, a TURN relay with fresh time-limited credentials. The list is empty when neither is configured.

Upgrades to a WebSocket (requires a same-origin Origin header; a foreign origin is refused with 403 by the upgrade handler). OpenAPI cannot model WebSocket frames, so the protocol is described here.

Every frame in both directions is a JSON text message `{"type": string, "payload": any}`. At most a few events per second per connection are processed; excess client events are dropped.

Server to client, on connect (to this connection only):
- `presence_snapshot`: map of user id to live status for every online user.
- `voice_snapshot`: map of voice channel id to a map of user id to User plus `joined_at`.
- `voice_rooms`: `{started: {channelId: time}, now}`; the server clock lets clients count up.

Server to client, broadcast to all connections:
- `message_create`, `message_update`: Message.
- `message_delete`: `{id, channel_id, parent_id}`.
- `message_reaction`: `{message_id, reactions}`.
- `channels_changed`: no payload; refetch GET /api/channels (sent after any category/channel/layout admin change).
- `member_joined`: public User of a newly registered member.
- `user_update`: public User after a profile, status or avatar change, or `{id, disabled}` when an admin disables or enables an account.
- `user_stats`: `{user_id, voice_seconds}` after a voice stay ends.
- `presence_update`: `{user_id, status}` where status is online, away, dnd, focus or offline.
- `voice_state_update`: `{action: "join", channel_id, user, started_at}` or `{action: "leave", channel_id, user_id}`.
- `voice_speaking`: `{channel_id, user_id, active}`.
- `typing`: `{channel_id, user_id}` (to everyone except the typist).

Server to client, targeted:
- `read_state`: to the user's own sessions only; `{channel_id, last_read_at, unread_count, mention_count}`, `{channel_id, last_read_at, refresh: true}` or `{channel_id, notify_level}`.
- `webrtc_media_state`: `{channel_id, user_id, screen, camera}` to voice-room members.
- `webrtc_offer` (SDP offer), `webrtc_candidate` (ICE candidate): SFU signalling.
- `voice_kicked`: `{channel_id}` when an admin removes the user from voice.
- `pong`: `{t}` echoing a `ping`.

Client to server:
- `ping` `{t}`; `presence_idle` `{idle: bool}`.
- `typing` `{channel_id}` (text channels only, rate-limited).
- `voice_join` `{channel_id}`; `voice_leave`; `voice_speaking` `{active}`.
- `webrtc_answer` (SDP answer), `webrtc_candidate` (ICE candidate), `webrtc_request_keyframe`.
- `webrtc_subscribe` `{kind: "screen"|"camera", user_id, on}` or `{kind: "camera", all: true, on}`.
- `webrtc_screenshare_stop`, `webrtc_camera_stop`.

Unknown event types are ignored. The server closes the connection when the session is revoked or the account is disabled.

101.description: Switching Protocols; the connection is now a WebSocket.

cookieAuth.name: mnema_session
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session cookie issued by POST /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register. The name is __Host-mnema_session when PUBLIC_URL is https.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input (INVALID_INPUT): malformed JSON, unknown JSON fields, bad IDs or failed validation.

Unauthorized.description: No valid session (UNAUTHORIZED): missing, expired or revoked cookie, or the account was disabled.

Forbidden.description: FORBIDDEN: not allowed (admin required, not the author, wrong current password) or cross-origin request rejected by the CSRF check.

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND: the resource, or the route, does not exist.

PayloadTooLarge.description: PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: body or file exceeds the limit (1 MiB for JSON).

UnsupportedMediaType.description: UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: the file type is not allowed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the client may retry.

Unavailable.description: UNAVAILABLE: a dependency (database, file storage) is not available.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code; clients branch on it.

ErrorResponse.description: Envelope used for every JSON error response.

Presence.description: A presence a user may choose. 'offline' is never chosen; it follows from having no open WebSocket.

avatar_url.description: API URL of the avatar (/api/media/{id}); omitted when none.

status_text.description: Free-text status line; empty when unset.

presence.description: The user's own chosen presence. Only present in responses about the caller's own account; omitted for other users (their live presence arrives over the WebSocket).

voice_seconds.description: Total time spent in voice rooms. Omitted when 0 and where stats are not loaded; set by GET /api/members and GET /api/users/{userID}.

message_count.description: Messages sent. Same availability rules as voice_seconds.

locale.description: Chosen UI language ('de' or 'en'); empty until chosen. GET /api/members always returns ''.

User.description: An account as members see it.

AdminUser.description: A user as listed in the admin panel.

deleted.description: True when the quoted message no longer exists; the fields below are then omitted.

content.description: First 200 characters of the quoted message.

parent_id.description: Thread root; omitted for top-level messages.

avatar_url.description: Omitted when the author has no avatar.

reply_to_id.description: Quoted message; omitted when not a reply.

mentions.description: IDs of users mentioned via @username, @all or @here (the author is never included).

unread_count.description: Top-level messages by others since the last read.

mention_count.description: Messages (including thread replies) mentioning or replying to the caller.

ReadState.description: Unread summary of one text channel for the caller.

image.description: Original absolute image URL; load it through /api/link-preview/image.

Legal.description: Operator details and facts the privacy policy must state.

CreateMessageRequest.description: parent_id must be a root message of the same channel; reply_to_id a message of the same conversation.

MarkReadRequest.description: Optional; the whole body may be omitted to mark everything read.

code.description: Generated (12 characters) when omitted or empty.

password.description: Shown once; never stored in plain text.

LayoutRequest.description: At most 500 entries in total. An unknown ID rejects the whole change.

file.description: At most MAX_UPLOAD_MB (config); type is sniffed and checked against an allowlist.
